name: Morph
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Braids' one-knob walk from triangle through saw to a narrowing pulse, into a low-pass that tracks the note and a tanh fuzz. Virtual analog shares the waveforms and has neither.

controls.label: Fuzz
controls.description: Closes the low-pass onto the note while raising the fuzz from dry to wet, welded as the module welds them.

controls.label: Shape
controls.description: Walks one oscillator from triangle through saw to square, then narrows the square into a pulse.

controls.label: Tone
controls.description: Offsets the low-pass five octaves either side of where Fuzz put it -- the coupling the module cannot undo.

controls.label: Drive
controls.description: Gain into the overdrive, from a soft saturation up to a hard clip. The module welds it at unity.

outputs.aux: The same morph oscillator dry, with neither the filter nor the fuzz on it.

upstream: Braids MacroOscillator::RenderMorph over AnalogOscillator::RenderTriangle, RenderSaw and RenderSquare
